doctrine: Camera height is a story decision measured from the featured character's eye-line (Patrick Lin). Size is chosen from the ladder against the subject's locked height. Lens follows relationship: wider to hold geography and two bodies, longer to press in on a thought. A subject under two feet tall is photographed from its own eye-line unless the view is about scale, so the world towers around it.
defaultHeight: eye level of the featured character

sizeLadder.name: medium wide
sizeLadder.use: knees up, two bodies in relation

sizeLadder.name: medium
sizeLadder.use: waist up, dialogue, business with hands

heightByAttention.scale: low, below the subject's eye-line, looking up
heightByAttention.threat: low, below the subject's eye-line, looking up
heightByAttention.world: above the canopy or at the horizon; not a character height

notes: Laws are not hashed by the canon lock. Heights come from canon/characters.json heightIn; this file never restates them.
